outcome: Extend the deterministic staging workflow with explicit snapshot-only content transformations that remove corporate GitHub owner references without modifying source repositories.
definition_of_done: Transformations run only inside an isolated exported snapshot.
Each repository requires explicit content transformation approval.
Every replacement is recorded with file path and replacement count.
Any remaining nandres_microsoft reference blocks the snapshot.
Fixture tests prove source content and Git state remain unchanged.

entries.rationale: PowerShell provides deterministic text replacement and audit generation inside the already isolated staging snapshot.
Git archive continues to provide the immutable source snapshot boundary before transformations run.

lower_level_evaluations.rationale: The existing deterministic staging primitive can be narrowly extended using its current PowerShell and Git capabilities.

capability_steamroll.rationale: The extension is a small repository-specific policy layer over standard text and Git primitives.
capability_steamroll.mitigation: Retire when a trusted publication platform provides equivalent snapshot transformation and audit controls.

initiative_collision.rationale: The extension remains inside the existing staging primitive rather than creating a new capability.
initiative_collision.mitigation: Keep repository-specific transformations declarative and avoid adding workflow orchestration.

durable_owner.accountability: Own transformation defaults, per-repository approval rules, audit evidence, and remaining-reference validation.

verification_evidence.claim: Tests must prove that source files and Git state are unchanged after snapshot transformation.
Snapshots with unresolved corporate owner references must be blocked.

boundaries.safety: Transformations may modify only exported staging snapshots. No source or remote mutation is authorized.
boundaries.privacy: Transformation reports remain ignored local state and contain paths and counts, not copied source content.
boundaries.human_review: Nick approves content transformation per repository before staging.
boundaries.rollback: Delete the generated snapshot and report; the source repository remains unchanged.

retirement_trigger: Retire when source repositories no longer need identity abstraction or a narrower trusted platform capability replaces it.
